tagline: Computer Engineering at Iowa State · AI systems, research & real-time engineering

paragraphs: I'm Vishnu, an AI and systems engineer. I'm a Founding Engineer at Hivemind ↗ (opens in a new tab), building Iris, an AI portfolio-intelligence platform.

I study Computer Engineering at Iowa State, where I'll also minor in AI, after two years of Computer Science at BITS Pilani. I build AI that holds up in production: LLM pipelines, knowledge graphs, real-time vision, and the systems underneath them.
